currentRoundInspection.scope: Four useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only; no bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected 2025 aerial from northwest: square central tower with open stone crown, curved corner/midface ribs, small pinnacles and central finial; broad lead-gray pitched nave/choir and lower aisle roofs; gabled pinnacled west front, pointed windows, corner turret/cone and stepped south ranges. Separate surrounding town buildings are not part of this asset.

Inspected south-facing elevated crown view: square solid lower tower with three tall pointed louvered openings on each visible face, pierced low crown railing, corner/midface curved flying ribs around open air, pinnacles and narrow tiered finial/weathercock. Stone weathering is not baked into materials.

Inspected west front: broad low sandstone cathedral, raised central gable with huge pointed tracery window, two inner pointed side windows and outer paired blind niches, carved pointed entrance below, vertical stepped buttress piers/pinnacles, lower aisle gables and northwest corner turret. Statue obscures some entry detail; exact sculpture/statue omitted.

Inspected east end: three pointed tracery windows, largest under central gable, lower flanking aisle roofs, tall buttress piers/pinnacles and sparse gable cresting. Southeast Thistle Chapel is lower with tall narrow pointed windows, buttresses, parapet and polygonal end. Windows use blue-gray glass and simplified tracery, not photographic stained glass.
